nodes.description: Storage.State.balance.debt: protocol debt tracked globally
Storage.State.balance.redeemable: dollars reserved for coupon redemption
Storage.State.balance.clippable: VSDs claimable by coupon holders
Storage.State.balance.coupons: aggregate outstanding coupon supply
Storage.State.epoch.current: current epoch counter
Storage.State.collateralRatio: ratio used when minting supply
Storage.State.poolList: array of Uniswap V2 pool addresses
Storage.State.collateralAssetList: assets redeemable for dollars
Storage.State.provider.dollar: IDollar token used for mint/burn/transfer
Storage.State.provider.oracle: IOracle price provider
ReentrancyGuard._status: _ENTERED/_NOT_ENTERED guard value
Storage.State.accounts: per-account coupon balances, allowances and lockedUntil
Collateral.redeem: nonReentrant, burns dollar and pays out collateral assets
Implementation.advance: nonReentrant EOA-only function driving epoch, regulator and market steps
Market.purchaseCoupons: burns dollar and issues expiring coupons
Market.extendCoupon: extends coupon expiration using additional dollars
Market.clipCoupons: converts redeemed coupons into transferable VSD
Market.transferCoupons: moves coupon balances with allowance support
Market.approveCoupons: sets coupon allowance for a spender
Bonding.bond: moves staged LP into bonded position and claims rewards
Bonding.unbond: moves bonded LP back to staged position
Bonding.deposit: stages LP tokens via transferFrom
Bonding.withdraw: onlyFrozen, returns staged LP tokens to caller
Bonding.provide: adds liquidity to a pool and bonds the resulting LP
Bonding.claim: pays out pending dollar reward to msg.sender
Govern.commit: governor-only upgrade after quorum and approval checks
Govern.emergencyCommit: governor-only upgrade after super-majority check
Govern.vote: EOA-only weighting by bonded dollar balance, locks the voter
Upgradeable.upgradeTo: writes implementation slot and delegatecalls initialize()
Bonding.addPool: governance-only registration of a Uniswap pool
Collateral.addCollateral: governance-only registration of a collateral asset
Setters._sellAndDepositCollateral: mints dollar and swaps it across pools
Setters._addLiquidity: quotes, transfers tokens and mints LP
Implementation.initialize: initializer-guarded pool flag setup
Comptroller.mintToAccount: mints dollar to an account and increases debt
Comptroller.burnFromAccountForDebt: pulls and burns dollar, decrements debt
msg.sender: attacker-controlled caller used for accounting and authorization
block.timestamp: miner-influenceable time source for epoch math
tx.origin: used as an EOA-vs-contract gate for advance and vote
External dollar token calls: transfer, transferFrom, mint and burn
IUniswapV2Pair.swap call that transfers control to an untrusted pool
newImplementation.delegatecall(initialize()) executed from upgradeTo
Inline assembly sstore writing the EIP-1967 implementation slot
SafeERC20.callOptionalReturn low-level call to arbitrary token contracts
oracle().capture() external call returning price and validity
blockTimestamp().sub(start).div(period).add(offset) epoch derivation
uint256 value parameter of redeem()
uint256 dollarAmount parameter of purchaseCoupons()
uint256 candidate parameter of commit/emergencyCommit/vote
Candidate.Vote vote parameter of vote()
address pool parameter of deposit/withdraw/bond/unbond/claim/provide
uint256 amount parameter of incentivize()
uint256 couponExpireEpoch parameter of extendCoupon/clipCoupons
uint256 couponAmount parameter of extendCoupon
uint256 dollarAmount parameter of extendCoupon
uint256 value parameter of deposit/withdraw/bond/unbond
Local uint256 actual (redeemable amount) computed in redeem()
Local uint256 debt snapshot used in redeem()
Local uint256 newDebt produced by shrinkSupply() during step

Local uint256 newSupply computed in increaseSupply()

edges.reason: msg.sender selects whose dollar is transferred and burned in redeem()
msg.sender is the account receiving coupon balances in purchaseCoupons()
msg.sender clips its own redeemed coupons in clipCoupons()
msg.sender is the stager of LP tokens in deposit()
msg.sender withdraws its staged LP tokens in withdraw()
msg.sender receives pending dollar rewards in claim()
msg.sender bonded dollar balance determines voting weight in vote()
msg.sender receives the advance incentive minted in advance()
msg.sender must equal address(this) for the governance-only addCollateral()
msg.sender must equal address(this) for the governance-only addPool()
advance() requires msg.sender == tx.origin, which can be bypassed by relayers of contract calls
vote() requires msg.sender == tx.origin as an EOA gate
block.timestamp feeds the epoch time computation
advance() emits block.timestamp and its step logic depends on epoch time
vote() window checks depend on epoch derived from block.timestamp
commit() validity window is computed from block.timestamp-derived epochs
emergencyCommit() timing checks rely on epoch values
claim()/unfreeze() lockup depends on epoch time
redeem() reads and reduces the global debt figure
redeem() consumes redeemable balance during settlement
redeem() interacts with clippable VSD accounting
redeem() burns the sender's dollar and coupon balances
redeem() performs dollar transferFrom/transfer external calls
redeem() performs SafeERC20 low-level calls to each collateral asset
redeem() settles the debt through burnFromAccountForDebt()
purchaseCoupons() requires totalDebt() >= dollarAmount
purchaseCoupons() increases aggregate coupon supply
purchaseCoupons() burns dollar through the token provider
purchaseCoupons() calls burnFromAccount() which routes to burnFromAccountForDebt()
clipCoupons() decrements redeemable in clipToAccount()
clipCoupons() increments clippable balance
clipCoupons() transfers dollar out to the claimer
transferCoupons() moves coupon balances between accounts and decrements allowance
bond() updates pool account bonded/staged balances
unbond() updates pool account bonded/staged balances
advance() increments the current epoch
advance() mints dollar incentives and moves supply
advance() mints the advance incentive via mintToAccount()
advance() drives Regulator.step which reads the oracle price
Oracle-provided price determines supply increase/decrease executed during advance()
_sellAndDepositCollateral() iterates the poolList
_sellAndDepositCollateral() mints dollar to itself and transfers it to pools
_sellAndDepositCollateral() mints and transfers dollar before interacting with the swap
_sellAndDepositCollateral() calls IUniswapV2Pair.swap on an external pool

upgradeTo() delegatecalls the candidate contract's initialize()

commit() triggers upgradeTo() after quorum, approval and governor checks
emergencyCommit() triggers upgradeTo() after super-majority and governor checks
extendCoupon() burns dollar via burnFromAccountForDebt()

normalization_plan.reason: The value parameter only exists inside redeem() and is fully absorbed by its redemption logic
dollarAmount is only meaningful within purchaseCoupons() accounting
candidate selects the implementation to upgrade in commit()
vote only selects the APPROVE/REJECT tally updated by vote()
pool addresses are resolved into pool storage by the bonding entry points
The incentivize amount is passed directly into mintToAccount()
couponExpireEpoch identifies the redemption slot consumed by clipCoupons()
couponAmount is only used in the extendCoupon() balance math
dollarAmount funds the debt burn performed inside extendCoupon()
The value parameter governs the staged-to-bonded transfer in bond()
actual is a transient redemption amount local to redeem()
debt is a transient snapshot of total debt local to redeem()
newDebt is produced by the regulator step executed inside advance()
couponAmount is the intermediate minted balance local to purchaseCoupons()
The cached epoch value only exists inside purchaseCoupons()
newSupply is produced by the supply increase path triggered by advance()
bondedLP is the LP amount returned by _addLiquidity() inside provide()
